P rominent figures from Nigeria’s banking, business, aviation and entertainment sectors during the week graced the surprise birthday celebration organised in honour of renowned businessman and co-founder of Seplat Energy, Ambroise Orjiako, popularly known as ABC Orjiako.
The private celebration was organised by the Executive Vice Chairman of Eraskorp Nigeria Limited, Maxwell Okon, in Lagos State.
It featured musical performances, a saxophone presentation and a live performance by Nigerian singer, Timi Dakolo, who entertained the celebrant and other guests.
The musical performances added glamour to the occasion, with Dakolo’s soulful rendition providing one of the highlights of the entertainment programme, while the saxophone presentation contributed to the celebratory atmosphere
The celebrant, who was visibly overwhelmed by the surprise, expressed appreciation to Okon and his team for organising the event in his honour.
He also thanked the guests who attended the celebration, acknowledging their presence and support as he marked another milestone in his life.
Among the dignitaries present at the gathering were the Managing Director and Chief Executive Officer of Fidelity Bank Plc, Nneka Onyeali-Ikpe; business mogul and Chairman of Heirs Holdings, Tony Elumelu; Chairman and Chief Executive Officer of Air Peace, Allen Onyema; and Chief Executive Officer of Prime Lagos, Prince Will, among other prominent personalities.
